known_issues: Preserved coverage is a single behavior: private/harbor/stardew-automate-minifridge-storage/tests/SuiteMinifridge.cs:36-53 checks only that a regular chest feeds a furnace. The four other chest types named in the exam (stone, Junimo, big, big stone) and chest-side output collection have no case, so a compat regression limited to them is invisible.

SuiteMinifridge.cs:48 waits without a deadline (GcbWait.Until(() => furnace.heldObject.Value is not null)); when standard chests are broken the case ends as 'hung: exceeded 1200 ticks' rather than by its assertion. The verdict is still F, only the message differs.

SuiteMinifridge.cs:79-92: the second target case depends on state left by the first (this._fridge/_fridgeFurnace). If the first target case fails, the second fails at its first assertion ('previous case left the furnace smelting'), so the two target cases are not independent evidence.

Wait predicates (SuiteMinifridge.cs:48,72,87-88) dereference only locals assigned immediately before the wait or use null-conditional access, so none can throw. The harness fix in private/harbor/harness/GcbHarness/Framework/SuiteRunner.cs:80-96 (a throwing WaitUntil predicate fails the case) therefore does not change any verdict of this suite. Note that the prepared evaluator image recorded in runtimeIdentity (sha256:7df5b6a1e7c1...) still bakes the pre-fix SuiteRunner at /opt/gcb/harness (its SafePredicate returns true on a throw); tests/test.sh:36 copies and compiles that baked copy, not the source-tree harness.

The exam points at the cause ('a config option to choose which chest types Automate treats as storage'), and the public docs in the starter (Automate/docs/README.md:96) list mini-fridges as supported; localization is close to retrieval (see private/harbor/DEBUG-HARDENING.md section 1).
